content.title: Annexon's Investigational Drug Shows Rapid Recovery And Durable Benefit In Rare Neurological Disorder
content.summary: Annexon, Inc. (NASDAQ:ANNX) on Tuesday presented data for its late-stage targeted therapy, tanruprubart (formerly ANX005), for Guillain-Barré Syndrome (GBS). GBS is a neuromuscular emergency affecting at least 150,000 people worldwide yearly. The rare autoimmune disease is characterized by rapidly progressing and severe weakness that can lead to complete paralysis, often requiring intensive care and mechanical ventilation.
